label: Coming of age
description: A young protagonist is pushed toward adulthood by a defining experience.

label: Identity or disguise
description: A protagonist adopts, loses, or conceals an identity in order to navigate the story.

label: Fish out of water
description: A protagonist is displaced into an unfamiliar community, culture, class, or way of life.

label: Unlikely partnership
description: Opposites or reluctant allies must work together toward a shared objective.

label: Family reconciliation
description: Estranged relatives must repair a damaged family bond or return to one another.

label: Forbidden romance
description: A love story is blocked by family, class, duty, allegiance, or another social boundary.

label: Love triangle
description: Romantic choice is complicated by a third person or competing attachments.

label: Revenge quest
description: A protagonist pursues retaliation or justice for a wrong committed against them or someone close.

label: Rescue mission
description: A protagonist must free or save a person, group, or community from immediate danger.

label: Missing-person search
description: A protagonist searches for someone who has disappeared, been abducted, or cannot be found.

label: Survival
description: A protagonist must stay alive or endure an extreme, hostile situation.

label: Pursuit and escape
description: A protagonist is hunted, chased, or forced to stay ahead of an active threat.

label: Witness protection
description: A witness or informant must survive after exposing a dangerous criminal or political force.

label: Undercover infiltration
description: A protagonist enters an enemy or criminal world under a false role to gather information or act from within.

label: Heist
description: A crew plans or carries out a coordinated theft, robbery, scam, or break-in.

label: Investigation
description: A protagonist follows evidence to solve a crime, mystery, murder, or hidden case.

label: Conspiracy
description: A protagonist uncovers or is trapped inside a coordinated secret plot.

label: Corruption exposed
description: A protagonist risks consequences to reveal institutional corruption, a cover-up, or a public scandal.

label: Courtroom defense
description: A legal battle, trial, or defense becomes the story's central contest.

label: Treasure hunt
description: A protagonist follows clues toward buried treasure, a lost artifact, or a legendary fortune.

label: Redemption
description: A compromised or disgraced protagonist seeks atonement through a second chance or difficult act.

label: Outsider versus institution
description: A maverick or outsider challenges a powerful system, authority, company, or establishment.

label: Political rebellion
description: A protagonist joins or leads a revolt, resistance, uprising, or struggle to overthrow power.

label: Wartime mission
description: A protagonist carries out a mission amid organized war, military conflict, or battle.

label: Disaster response
description: A protagonist responds to a natural, technological, or planetary catastrophe.

label: Monster threat
description: A protagonist confronts a creature, alien, supernatural force, or other inhuman threat.

label: Supernatural bargain
description: A protagonist accepts a magical, demonic, or otherwise supernatural bargain with a cost.

label: Race against time
description: A deadline or countdown compresses the protagonist's choices and action.

label: Sports underdog
description: An unlikely athlete or team fights through competition toward a meaningful win.

label: Performance competition
description: Performers or artists compete for a role, contest, audience, or breakthrough.

label: Mentor and protégé
description: An experienced guide trains, protects, or transforms a less experienced protagonist.

label: Power struggle
description: Competing figures or factions fight to control a family, organization, territory, or public role.

label: Second chance
description: A protagonist is given an unusual opportunity to correct, revisit, or relive a former failure.
